votes.question: On Passage of the Bill S. 2296
On the Amendment S.Amdt. 3927 to S.Amdt. 3748 to S. 2296 (No short title on file)
votes.amendmentDetail: To limit the use of Federal law enforcement officers for crowd control, and for other purposes.

votes.question: On the Amendment S.Amdt. 3853 to S.Amdt. 3748 to S. 2296 (No short title on file)
votes.amendmentDetail: To reduce the bloated Pentagon budget by 10 percent and instead expand veteran dental care at the Department of Veterans Affairs.

votes.question: On the Amendment S.Amdt. 3210 to S.Amdt. 3748 to S. 2296 (No short title on file)
votes.amendmentDetail: To limit the provision of support by the Armed Forces to civilian law enforcement activities.

votes.question: On the Amendment S.Amdt. 3872 to S.Amdt. 3748 to S. 2296 (No short title on file)
votes.amendmentDetail: To amend title 32, United States Code, to clarify certain limitations on full-time National Guard duty performed in a State, Territory, or the District of Columbia.

votes.question: On the Amendment S.Amdt. 3109 to S.Amdt. 3748 to S. 2296 (No short title on file)
votes.amendmentDetail: To prohibit the use of funds to procure or modify foreign aircraft for presidential airlift.

votes.question: On the Amendment S.Amdt. 3697 to S.Amdt. 3748 to S. 2296 (No short title on file)
votes.amendmentDetail: To require a review of the methodologies used to determine the amounts of locality-based comparability payments and to require the President's Pay Agent to conduct a pilot program establishing alternative models for determining the amounts of those payments.

votes.question: On the Amendment S.Amdt. 3535 to S.Amdt. 3748 to S. 2296 (No short title on file)
votes.amendmentDetail: To require Presidential appointment and Senate confirmation of the Inspector General of the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System and the Bureau of Consumer Financial Protection.

votes.question: On the Amendment S.Amdt. 3761 to S.Amdt. 3748 to S. 2296 (No short title on file)
votes.amendmentDetail: To prohibit earnings on balances maintained at a Federal Reserve bank by or on behalf of a depository institution.

votes.question: On the Motion to Table S.Amdt. 3849 to S. 2296 (No short title on file)
votes.description: Motion to Table Schumer Amdt. No. 3849
votes.amendmentDetail: To direct the Attorney General to make publicly available documents related to Jeffrey Epstein.
